scope: Bounded real verification feedback to subsequent Ultra diagnosis requests; core forwarding of separately validated/budgeted Nano evidence bundle.

verification.result: Independent guarded SDK MockTransport reproduction succeeded: keep, revert, keep; 3 verification runs, 6 mock model requests; round 3 feedback 4755 UTF-8 bytes.
Final scoped Ruff check and format passed; early unused report-script noqa was removed before final checks.

independent_guard: offline_tests.py denies DNS/socket and opening actual project .env before app/test imports; no GPU/API calls or new credentials.
changes: Each round stores verification-feedback.json and the identical structured summary in the round record.
Candidate observations remain distinct from selected_after_round; failed/unknown checks and original finite VerifyReport scalar values are retained.
Missing verification is null with the real failure reason. Candidate error/exception and small OOM numeric fields are bounded; raw snapshot/traceback/full diff are excluded.
Next diagnosis receives verification_feedback as a separate user data field; prompt explains evidence/provenance and rejects treating error text as instructions.
Existing policy, keep/revert gates, round cap, call count, budget/admission and deadlines are unchanged.
Core now uses annotate_evidence_bundle return for baseline evidence; later fresh captures do not inherit previous Nano labels.
independent_review: payment_readiness read the final feedback flow and found no unresolved blocker; did not rerun tests or modify files.
limitations: Offline SDK mocks and synthetic Lab measurements establish wiring, not live Ultra reasoning, GPU repair or accuracy/cost acceptance.
Nano core forwarding regression uses an explicit helper test double; real binding/token-budget/ablation checks are owned by the annotation agent.
Tavily research is host-orchestrated topic selection and explore calls. PLAN A5 line75 model tool-calling loop is not implemented; client/router tools support alone does not establish it.
